verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, and whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source release or any license. The docs cover only proprietary platform features, and the probes find only an llms.txt and no public code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
